litematica-printer.config.generic.commen: Use a shovel to clear snow layers blocking schematic paths or farmland. Farmland also requires a hoe. Leaves snow blocks, powder snow and schematic snow intact.
Allow dirt for schematic grass blocks in Easy Place. Held dirt takes priority; otherwise use dirt if no grass blocks are available. Does not modify the schematic.

Easy Place and Printer plant supported crops at age zero and accept existing crops of the same type regardless of age. Other properties remain significant. Does not change schematic rendering or verification.

Mine different block types at non-air schematic positions in Printer and Easy Place. Skips state-only differences, block entities, accepted substitutes and transformation steps. Default OFF. Hold use on the target for Easy Place mining.
